items.note: The prompt never says the product is a B2B note-taking app.
The audience (engineering and design leads) and the kickoff purpose aren't mentioned.
The v1 scope (creating a workspace, inviting members by email, shared notes) isn't stated.
The admin and member roles aren't mentioned.
The out-of-scope items (billing, SSO, guest access) aren't listed.
The success metric (20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days) is absent.
The length limit of about 2 pages isn't stated.
The prompt doesn't say to leave migration of existing shared notes as an open question.
